definitions.explanation: One of the most common Japanese surnames.

examples.japanese: {鈴木|すずき}{夫妻|ふさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{鈴木|すずき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：00607_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：02790_nibanme⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：00413_ooi⟧⟦{名字|みょうじ}→名字：02679_myouji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Suzuki is the second most common surname in Japan.

notes:
{鈴木|すずき} is one of the most common Japanese surnames.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {鈴|すず}: bell
- {木|き}: tree
- Origin associated with Shinto shrines using sacred wands with bells
